diaspora_bullets: Three of the six laureates are based outside India
Winners include researchers at Princeton and Carnegie Mellon
news_summary: Six researchers won the Infosys Prize 2026, announced November 12 in Bengaluru by the Infosys Science Foundation, including legal scholar Gautam Bhatia, recognised for contributions to constitutional law and legal scholarship.
payoff: Each laureate receives a gold medal, a citation and $100,000.
